artworks.title: Peasants Outside a Farm Slaughtering a Pig
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 11.5 × 11.6 cm (4 1/2 × 4 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a fallen animal outside a rustic building. The scene is depicted within an oval frame. In this detailed black and white etching, several figures in the foreground are dressed in simple, historical costumes typical of rural life, surrounding what appears to be a pig lying on the ground. One individual appears to be actively involved with the animal, while others stand by. The background reveals a thatched roof building with visible wooden beams and windows, and a large tree arching overhead. The drawing captures a moment of everyday rural activity with intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Man Paying the Landlady at an Inn
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.5 × 8.7 cm (4 1/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene in a rustic setting. The image depicts a room with a high ceiling and wooden beams, featuring a large hearth at the center. The room is lit by natural light coming through paned windows on the left. Numerous household items are visible around the room, illustrating a lived-in space. The walls are adorned with shelves holding items such as pottery and utensils. In the foreground, two figures are engaged in an interaction near the entrance, while a group of four can be seen in the background around a table. The lines and textures capture the details of the room's architecture and furnishings, reflecting a scene from everyday life in an earlier time period.

artworks.title: Peasant Family Entertained by a Fiddler with a Hunchback
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a village scene with buildings, people, and vegetation. The architecture includes rough walls, lattice windows, thatched roofs, wooden beams, and stairs. People are engaged in everyday activities near a doorway. A stone structure in the background contrasts with the lush vegetation. The drawing is detailed, showing historical village life through precise lines and shadow play.

artworks.title: Peasant Family in an Interior with the Mother Feeding a Child
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.8 x 15.8 cm (7 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic interior scene. It depicts a detailed view of a modest dwelling with various household objects scattered throughout. Objects like pots, a basket, wooden furniture, and overhanging linens are visible. A ladder leans against the back wall, leading to a loft area filled with barrels and other storage. Dark beams stretch across the ceiling. The composition is carefully structured to draw the eye through these details, creating an intimate portrayal of home life. The drawing is intricate, with fine lines capturing texture and depth, lending a sense of authenticity to the domestic setting.

artworks.title: Village Kermesse with Peasants Feasting Under a Pergola
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a village gathering with detailed line work. Closest to the viewer, villagers are engaged in various activities near thatched-roof structures and trees. A pig grazes nearby. The scene has a monochromatic color palette, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts for depth. The composition extends to the right with more people, tents, and buildings suggesting a larger communal event in the background.

artworks.title: Village Kermesse with Peasants Feasting Under a Pergola
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.7 × 17.5 cm (5 × 6 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a village gathering or festivity. The composition includes a thatched-roof cottage on the left with people engaging in activities. Trees cover the top portion of the scene, separating the sky. The artwork is finely detailed with intricate line work, creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of sepia and beige. Figures can be seen moving into the distance, where a road narrows, bordered by more structures and trees, with a pig grazing nearby.

artworks.title: Peasants Feasting at an Inn
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring various activities. The image shows a rustic setting, possibly an inn or communal living space, with a large group of figures engaged in different actions. The room is detailed with wooden beams, a slanted ceiling, household objects like baskets and pots, and a hanging chair. The central focus is on a group of figures sharing drinks, talking, or gesturing. A fireplace and hearth add warmth to the scene. The overall atmosphere is lively and bustling with communal activity.

artworks.title: Hurdy-Gurdy Player in a Tall Hat
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a person from the waist up with their body turned slightly to the left and head bent forward. The individual's facial features are obscured, and they have short hair beneath a large hat with a feather. The person wears a cloak or loose coat with folds covering the upper body, and their hands are clasped around the garment. The artwork is in a monochrome etching style with a plain background. A signature and the year 1647 are located to the right of the figure.

artworks.title: Interior of a Courtyard
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural structure with a slightly elevated angle, displaying the side of the building and a partial view of another structure behind it. The focus is on the detailing of the architecture, depicted with precise lines and shading to render the textures of wooden planks and roof tiles. The color palette consists of soft browns, grays, and earthy tones, conveying the natural materials. Shadows and light are suggested with variations in tone, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Brawl in an Inn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and touches of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a black and brown ink drawing on paper depicting several figures engaging in activities in an interior setting. The figures are sketched with fluid lines amidst various objects and structures. Some figures are sitting or reclining, while others are standing and gesturing. The background includes architectural elements like walls and an archway, creating a sense of enclosure. The drawing conveys a dynamic energy and interaction between the forms, suggesting a narrative.

artworks.title: The Lovers
artworks.artist: Wenzel von Olmutz after Master of the Housebook
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals seated on a bench. The person on the left is a woman dressed in a long gown with long sleeves and a high neckline. She wears a turban-like headpiece, and her eyes are closed. Her hands hold a small animal. The person on the right is a man sitting barefoot with one leg crossed over the other. He wears a loose shirt and a hat with feathers. He has wavy hair falling to his shoulders. There is an ornate arch above them. To the left, there is a potted plant with flowers beside the woman. On the ground in front of the bench, a small circular basin with a pitcher inside can be seen. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Farmer and Wife with Goose
artworks.artist: Wenzel von Olmutz after Master of the Housebook
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a woman standing facing each other. The man is on the left, carrying a stick over his shoulder with a sack. He wears a headpiece and his clothing consists of a belted tunic and trousers. He carries a knife on his belt. The woman stands on the right, wearing a headscarf and a long dress with a cinched waist. She holds a duck or goose under her arm. The background shows a simple, grass-like landscape with a plain border framing the composition.

artworks.title: The Deluge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a flood scene. The image shows numerous figures in a deluge, struggling to survive. Some are holding onto animals or each other, others are in dramatic poses. In the background, there is a large boat, likely an ark. The scene is detailed with various activities and emotions, portraying humanity's struggle against natural forces. The tone emphasizes the chaos and emotional turmoil caused by the flood.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: The image shows two figures next to a well. One figure on the left has long hair and a beard, wearing a loose robe, standing with one foot visible, and one hand extended towards the well. The figure on the right is leaning over the well, with a hand on a bucket, wearing a detailed, long dress and a head covering with decorative ear-like ornaments. Both figures are barefoot. There is a jug near their feet. The background includes a rural landscape with trees, a distant town or settlement, and smaller figures engaged in various activities. The year "1523" is inscribed at the top and there are initials near the jug at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Christ
artworks.description: This is an illustration featuring a robed figure on the left and a winged figure on the right engaged in conversation. The robed figure has long hair, a beard, a halo, and is barefoot, wearing a robe. The winged figure wears a horned helmet and ornate armor, with large wings. The background shows a rural landscape with trees, clouds, and distant buildings. The artwork is detailed, with fine lines, textures, and shading highlighting the figures and the environment.

artworks.title: Christ Summoning Peter
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene set near a body of water with two individuals in a boat handling a fishing net. In the background, there is a detailed depiction of a serene rural landscape with trees, a castle on a hill, and scattered thatched-roof houses among lush greenery. The water is depicted with gentle ripples and reflections, while the foreground features textured landscapes with tufts of grass and stones. The sky above is filled with soft billowing clouds. The drawing style suggests intricate line work and cross-hatching to create shading and texture.

artworks.title: Saint James the Less and Saint Simon
artworks.description: Two full-bodied figures are positioned on either side of an ornate central pillar. On the left, a man stands with his body slightly angled toward the right. He has curly hair and a full beard, with noticeable lines accentuating his facial features. He wears a long, flowing robe and keeps his hands on an elongated stick. The figure on the right also stands with a direct posture, looking straight ahead. He wears a headpiece covering his short, receding hair, holds a book in one hand, and a large, serrated saw in the other. Both figures wear long robes and seem to have haloes behind their heads. The background features an intricate design, matching the style of the figures and the central pillar. The ground they stand on appears flat, and both men are barefoot.

artworks.title: Procession of Feasting Lepers
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.1 x 22.7 cm (6 3/4 x 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people gathered closely together, with diverse facial features. They are shown standing and sitting in a crowded formation, focusing on the scene in the center. The individuals wear various hats and long robes with intricate patterns. One person in the center holds a staff adorned with greenery and objects, while another nearby holds a large pitcher. The background shows a rustic setting with trees, buildings resembling a European village, and a horse and rider in the distance. Architectural elements with the year "1608" inscribed above a windowed wall provide historical context to the image.

artworks.title: The Seller of Rat Poison
artworks.description: The image shows two people. The older individual is holding a small rectangular object in his left hand and a wooden box in his right hand. He has a weathered face with deep-set features, heavy eyebrows, and a long beard. The younger person is holding a large pole with a woven basket on top. The background features a stone arch, a large leafless tree, and soft clouds.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Woman (Visscher's Mother)
artworks.description: The image shows the profile of an older woman's head and upper torso. She faces the right side with her head slightly tilted down. She has a prominent nose, soft wrinkles, partially visible eyes gazing downward, and subtly pursed lips. Her hair is concealed under a patterned headscarf tied tightly at the back. She wears a heavy garment with a fur collar. The background is a simple, dark textured pattern.

artworks.title: Title Page: Two Cripples Receiving Alms
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving three figures. One figure is depicted on an upper surface passing something down to the two figures below. One of the lower figures is kneeling and holding a cup, while the other is seated and gesturing upwards. The drawing includes text in a decorative script, possibly a title, artist's signature, and date, 1652. The artwork features intricate line work typical of the 17th century, capturing details of clothing and expressions, conveying a lively and dynamic scene.

artworks.title: Beggar with a Wooden Leg
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, leaning forward and holding two crutches. The individual has a somber expression, unkempt hair, and is wearing tattered clothing with layers visible underneath. They appear to be wearing flat shoes. The background features sparse vegetation and a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Beggar Carrying a Woman on His Back
artworks.description: The image shows a person hunched over and leaning on a stick. They appear to be elderly, with thin hair and tattered clothing. The person is holding a long stick for support, with a simple background behind them.

artworks.title: Beggar with Two Crutches
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back turned towards the viewer. The person is using a cane for support in each hand. They have wild, flowing hair or feathers and a cap on their head. Their face is not visible due to the angle. They wear layered, tattered clothing, long trousers, and shoes. A small container is attached to their clothing by a strap. The background includes some vegetation and plants. The top right corner features the signature "J. van vliet."
